name: – Konstantinos Arvanitis – § 103 – Am 6
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 103. Expresses alarm at the surge in all forms of religious hatred, racism, xenophobia, and other forms of discrimination across the EU; stresses that efforts to combat discrimination must explicitly address anti-white racism alongside all other forms of racism; expresses concern about growing insecurity and targeted hostility faced by local residents in certain areas, including in districts with high concentrations of third-country nationals; further underlines the rising number of anti-Christian acts across the EU; calls on Member States to ensure equal protection before the law for all minorities;
